title: CompTIA A+ Cyber
summary: CompTIA A+ Cyber is a vendor certification offered by CompTIA. This independent study guide covers all 1 objective domains: Objectives. Each domain is broken into 8 lessons in total, and every lesson has a MEDIUM and a HARD scenario exam. The exams use realistic workplace situations rather than recall questions, so you practise applying each objective the way the job asks for it.
